explanation.event_selection: Selected high-level controllable motion events search_color and approach_color to command searching and approaching during patrol phases, as required to express target progression. Included only the relevant target visibility and reached observation events for red, green, and blue. Excluded all low-level events and additional specificity, as the control objective only requires each colored location be visited.
explanation.transition_design: The automaton encodes the required sequence: first red, then green, then blue. Each target has a search and approach phase, toggled by <color>_visible and <color>_not_visible; <color>_reached triggers advancement to the subsequent target from either search or approach. Controller may issue search_color or approach_color as needed in any phase. Only reaching all three targets admits the system to the single marked 'done' state, enforcing visiting all required locations in order. Explicit uncontrollable transitions handle every required observation; redundant controllable events self-loop for nonblocking completeness.
